svg.title: Example: Blameless Incident Review
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape blameless incident review: summary and severity, ground rules, a timeline of what people knew, contributing factors, what helped, where we got lucky, and follow-up actions.
svg.text: Learn from an incident without blame: what happened, why it made sense at the time, and how to make it less likely.
Improve · Blameless Post-Incident Review · Learning from Incidents · Systems, Not People
We look at systems, not at who to blame
People did what made sense with what they knew
What we learn is shared openly
WHAT DID PEOPLE KNOW AT EACH POINT?
USUALLY SEVERAL · RARELY ONE ROOT CAUSE
“Why did it make sense to them at the time?”
“What would make the next incident less likely, or easier to recover from?”

g.text: Payment provider rotated its API certificate
nothing: no alert on certificate errors
a few complaints, looked like card issues
customer service told people to retry
Sam paged; looked at our last release
Logs show certificate errors to the provider
it's the provider's change, not ours
Platform team joined; rolled back the release
watched for 30 minutes, then closed it
